why: The load-bearing arm, and the one a strict reading gets backwards. `concept` declares `enables` and `relates-to` and states no `edge_policy`, so its vocabulary is UNSTATED — a non-empty `edges:` says these relationships exist, not and no others may. A server that rejects `leads-to` here refuses legal queries against every corpus written before `edge_policy` existed; reading it as an exhaustive list put 210 errors on a compliant corpus, which is why the field exists. So this RUNS, matches nothing, and says why in `diagnostics` — a warning is not a rejection, and `rejected` MUST stay null.
